description: The host's answer to one EmailSaveRequest. The editor only clears its dirty flag and shows "Saved" for Saved; a Failed keeps the document dirty, and a Conflict additionally pauses auto-save until a successful manual/programmatic save or a new document reference.

members.name: Conflict
members.description: Creates a conflict result (a stale revision) carrying the host's optional reason.

members.name: Failed
members.description: Creates a failure result carrying the host's optional reason.

members.name: Saved
members.description: Creates the result that confirms the snapshot was persisted.

members.name: IsSaved
members.description: Gets whether the host confirmed the write — the only state in which the editor may say "Saved".

members.name: Message
members.description: Gets the host's optional reason for a Failed or Conflict result. The host localizes it; the editor shows it verbatim next to its own localized status label.
